Name: Eden-Class Babylonia
Desc:
Filled with the unprecedented aspirations of humanity, Babylonia was supposed to be the first-ever superluminal starship for interstellar colonization.
Its massive construction alone has ushered in a new era of human history, the Golden Age, where human beings stayed united and evolved.
After the virus outbreak, the construction of Babylonia was forcibly terminated. Babylonia became the shelter for many survivors who had escaped to space.
Now, Babylonia is anchored in the arc orbital dock and, as the starting point for taking back Earth, it maintains close ties with ground forces.

Name: Commercial Square
Desc: A massive commercial property developed under the initiative of Babylonia Commercial Council, serving as a landmark building of the Commercial District.\nThe Commercial Square integrates diverse business formats with rich functionality, meeting people's varied needs for daily shopping, social gatherings, business negotiations, and leisure entertainment.

Name: Commercial Square
Desc: A massive commercial property developed under the initiative of Babylonia Commercial Council, serving as a landmark building of the Commercial District.\nThe Commercial Square integrates diverse business formats with rich functionality, meeting people's varied needs for daily shopping, social gatherings, business negotiations, and leisure entertainment.

Name: Stella Brew
Desc: A comprehensive leisure venue located within the Commercial District, renowned for its exquisite mixed drinks.\nThe menu covers various classic specialty drinks and flavored beverages, catering to the tastes of all customers.\nPerfect for both enjoying quiet moments alone and spending time with friends, Stella Brew attracts numerous customers from Babylonia with its quality drinks at affordable prices and perfectly balanced relaxed atmosphere.

Name: Kuroro Coffee
Desc: A popular coffee shop in the Commercial District, operated by Ross, an owner with extensive professional experience.\nKuroro Coffee features a minimalist and practical layout design, divided into bar seating and general seating areas.\nThe cafe is equipped with standardized coffee-making equipment, capable of providing various types of coffee along with rich seasonings to meet customers' personalized needs.

Name: Orbital Corridor
Desc: A commercial street that brings together various types of shops, including food shops, clothing shops, and more.\nAs an important component of the Commercial District, Orbital Corridor provides residents with a convenient shopping option.

Name: Sequence Square
Desc: An outdoor public space located in the Residential District, serving as one of the important links connecting to the Commercial District.\nDue to its convenient location, Sequence Square serves as both a place for residents' daily leisure activities and a landmark with heavy foot traffic.

Name: Sequence Square
Desc: An outdoor public space located in the Residential District, serving as one of the important links connecting to the Commercial District.\nDue to its convenient location, Sequence Square serves as both a place for residents' daily leisure activities and a landmark with heavy foot traffic.

Name: Commandant's Lounge
Desc: An exclusive lounge Babylonia prepared for the Commandant.\nThe room is equipped with comprehensive home facilities and necessary office equipment.\nThese ensure the Commandant can get adequate rest during downtime between missions while also enabling rapid handling of affairs and issuing of orders when emergencies arise.

Name: "Dreamweaver World"
Desc: A land of blooming pink mountain flowers, beaches, ocean, brilliant seaside fireworks...\nThe Dreamweaver World device constructed this ideal dreamscape for the Commandant and Lucia based on keywords they provided.

Name: Babylonia Commercial District
Desc: "Plazas, cinemas, shopping arcades, and crowds of people... they used to be everywhere on Earth during the Golden Age. Now, this place stands as the last echo of that past prosperity.\n...Is it meaningless? No, I don't believe so. People need moments to rest, and to remember. To understand what we once lost, and what we're still fighting with all our strength to take back."\n— Babylonia Commercial District: 10th Anniversary Feature Interview

Name: Babylonia District Overview
Desc: Architecture begins with a question and ends in the search for an answer. Babylonia, this immense man-made structure flying in Earth's orbit, stands as an ever-evolving response from architects to the challenge of survival in the wake of the Punishing crisis.The distinct sectors we see today—divided by function yet diverse in form—transcend both time and culture. Their overlapping styles faithfully mirror the circumstances our predecessors faced, and the solutions they dared to attempt.This book is written to guide those who come after us, so they may walk this long path and discover their own answers. And above all, let us remember this: it is humanity's love and hope for its home that architecture was always meant to carry.— Preface to Introduction to Architecture in the Post-Pandemic Age

Name: Babylonia - Commercial District B
Desc:
One of Babylonia's most important cultural and leisure zones, master-planned by WGAA and formed by three landmark spaces: Olympia Art Gallery, Babylonia Universal Cinema, and Dreamglow Gardens.
This corridor, woven from stories, art, and greenery, offers residents a place to rest the mind and enjoy life.
It is a classroom of aesthetic awakening, a hub of emotional connection, and a living artery of memory and legacy.
In the silence of space, it protects humanity's spiritual home, preserving the warmth and memory of civilization.

Name: Babylonia Commercial District
Desc:
When people ask why art galleries were built inside a shelter, I always think of the things I can never restore, those that remain only as data archives... everything about Earth.
What has already been lost tells us what shaped the "us" we are today.
And what we preserve, along with what we newly create, will tell us what kind of "us" we may choose to become in the future.
— Special Interview: Tenth Anniversary of the Babylonia Commercial District

Name: Knowledge Promenade
Desc: An open-air square corridor connecting the Olympia Art Gallery and the Babylonia Universal Cinema, renovated under the direction of WGAA to provide visitors with up-to-date exhibition information.Serving as a passage between two major cultural landmarks, the Knowledge Promenade carries forward the aesthetic language of the main halls, extending art beyond indoor spaces and into the public realm.Its overall landscape design moves in dialogue with the drifting blue whale projections, offering visitors a seamless and immersive experience.As a bridge between art and everyday life, it has become a beloved sanctuary for impromptu performances, sketching sessions, and romantic dates.

Name: Olympia Art Gallery
Desc: A public art gallery founded by WGAA, set in the heart of the B-2167 cabin section's Commercial District. It's a full-spectrum institution that brings together popular science education, curated collections, and research.The main building takes the form of a starship docked in the galaxy. Geometric panels link together into a light, flowing, asymmetrical space, casting layered, irregular patterns of light and shadow.Paired with the gigantic blue whale projections that drift through the square and inner hall, the structure becomes a spatial installation that feels alive, breathing with both grace and force.With its sense of freedom and romance, it has grown into one of Babylonia's signature sights.

Name: Olympia Art Gallery - Entrance Hall
Desc: One of Babylonia's iconic landmarks, envisioned as humanity's ark anchored in the galaxy, with wandering blue whales evoking memories of a distant homeland.\nClassical sculpture and digital art stand in quiet dialogue here. Technological rationality and human warmth resonate and blend, gently shaping aesthetic awareness through history, art, and reflection.\nIt is both a tranquil vessel for contemplation and an incubator for creativity, forever preserving the story of where we came from.

Name: Babylonia Universal Cinema
Desc: A comprehensive film and visual archive jointly operated by WGAA and the Babylonia Universal, with support from a specialized research center under the Science Council, located at the heart of the Commercial District.The center features VR immersive viewing systems alongside traditional large-screen theaters, spanning the full spectrum from film reels to holographic cinema and offering audiences a wide range of viewing options.Its affiliated research institute preserves a vast collection of physical visual media from the Golden Age to the present, supporting ongoing restoration, interpretation, and archival research.This work provides a solid foundation for technological reconstruction across disciplines, as well as for ethnographic and cultural documentation efforts that safeguard humanity's heritage.

Name: Babylonia Universal Cinema - Theater
Desc: The Commercial District's most prosperous cultural landmark. It hosts themed film festivals, pop-up events, and art exhibitions, and serves as a key source of funding for cultural heritage preservation projects.The VR theaters feature neural-interface pods, allowing audiences to step directly into legendary stories. Meanwhile, upgraded full-field sound systems in traditional large-screen theaters breathe new life into classic films.This place is not only where visual wonders are born, but also where emotional connections take shape. The shared rhythm of breath in the darkness, rising and falling with the same story, reminds us—That even as humans live alone in near-Earth orbit, we are still the children who once gathered around a fire, listening to our mother tell distant tales.

Name: Dreamglow Gardens
Desc:
An open greenhouse oasis located in the Commercial District, and a key node within Babylonia's ecological network.
The Science Council has established many such green spaces to restore agricultural capacity and protect plant species of strategic importance.
As one of the few greenhouses open to the public, Dreamglow Gardens combines leisure, education, and research.
Through detailed ecological simulation, it recreates the seasonal rhythms of rare plants once native to Earth.

Name: Dreamglow Gardens - Atrium Greenhouse
Desc:
Transparent geometric structures and carefully layered greenery come together to form the airy atrium greenhouse of Dreamglow Gardens.
Within the central vertical cultivation system, flowering and foliage plants in various forms create quiet corners where visitors can slow down and rest.
Trellis-style monitoring devices display plant records, while synced growth data helps adjust environmental conditions and supports remote ecological courses from the Youth Center.
This is a museum of Earth's living memory. A cosmic oasis of homeland, longing, and hope. A gentle breath within the endless vacuum.

Name: Military Security Area - Assembly Hall
Desc: The Assembly Hall of the Military Security Area, where rapid-access corridors for combat personnel intersect with emergency transport systems, serving as the first transit point between units.\nThis is the final stop before deployment. Every silent figure rushing out carries fleeting opportunities and dangers balanced on a knife's edge.

Name: Military Security Area - War Conference Room
Desc:
The most fundamental facility of the Military Security Area, and its smallest decision-making hub.
Beyond the automated gates lies the space where squads assemble and receive their orders.
With holographic sand tables and blast-resistant tactical desks, these standardized rooms have been the starting point for countless one-of-a-kind miracles created by Commandants and Constructs alike.
May every story end with us returning here, ready to set out once more.

Name: Space Voyage
Desc: Multiple space crises following the Punishing outbreak left behind vast amounts of spacecraft and facility debris, interfering with Babylonia's navigation safety and space surveillance.\nTo keep the base running safely, the Support Force maintains routine drone deployments, conducting regular space operations to clear and recycle scattered wreckage and obsolete structures.\nEngineering Force specialists are permanently stationed on the third floor of the Military Security Area, providing technical support and iterative upgrades for the drone swarms to ensure continuous improvements in space operation efficiency.

Name: Military Security Area
Desc: A restricted military area built around the central military elevator, radiating outward to cover all of Babylonia.\nAt its core, the elevator uses a dual-track transport system, separating personnel and cargo to ensure rapid response and reliable supply.\nThe War Conference Room serves as the tactical hub, where elite Constructs stand ready. From tiered defensive nodes across Babylonia to real-time deployments on Earth's battlefield, humanity's march to reclaim its home never stops.

Name: Security Checkpoint Bridge
Desc: The final security checkpoint linking the Commercial District and the central military elevator. This militarized rapid-access corridor uses cutting-edge technology to perform scans on all personnel and cargo.\nThrough reinforced bulletproof glass on either side of the corridor, visitors can see the outer structure of Babylonia. Inside the passage, dedicated logistics lines handle bulk cargo bound for the military elevator.\nArmed patrol units and fully automated gun turrets form a dual-layer defense here, an unbreakable steel barrier established by the World Government guard forces.

Name: Logistics Center
Desc: The Babylonia Commercial District's logistics transfer station, responsible for the automated routing of all bulk supplies.\nDrone swarms and intelligent machines form a fully automated logistics pipeline, allowing precise and efficient distribution across the district.\nIt is a solid foundation that keeps daily life in Babylonia running smoothly.

Name: Frostheart Shadow
Desc: Rosetta fell into a coma after confronting enemies that emerged in the Arctic regions. Somewhere within Babylonia, there should be a way to help her recover.

Name: Frostheart Shadow
Desc: The "Mina" who appeared in Babylonia was not the real one. After the attempted attack failed, he took advantage of the chaos to slip away, and Rosetta, who had just regained consciousness, immediately went after him.

Name: Frostheart Shadow
Desc: After the chase, everyone comes to the rooftop of the Military Security Area.

Name: Frostheart Shadow
Desc: The declaration of the "Frostheart Emperor" signals the beginning of a new wave of crisis and turmoil. Per Asimov's instructions, go find him first and talk through what to do next.

Name: F.O.S. Starship Module
Desc: A spark ignited by Dominik, carrying the ideals and hopes of the future—a torch of humanity's spirit from the Golden Age. It also served as the starting point of the M.I.N.D. Phylotree of Ousia and witnessed humanity's tragic past regarding M.I.N.D. issues.

Name: Overlapping Ring District
Desc: Recreational districts on the two sides of the street, frequently visited by students who are looking to relax during their free time. The area is equipped with living facilities, logistics conveyor belts, and other basic infrastructure, along with benches and other leisure spaces.

Name: Spectrum Garden
Desc: A small recreational garden outside F.O.S. Military Command College. The central device projects the F.O.S. school crest, where technological light patterns interweave with the greenery, creating a tranquil corner for students to relax during their free time.

Name: Collaborative Teaching Center
Desc: The Collaborative Teaching Center is F.O.S.'s core educational facility. The department offers over forty theoretical and practical courses, covering many topics from space military engineering, modern military theory, to Construct command strategies and more.

Name: Study Hall
Desc: The core teaching space, equipped with holographic projection, intelligent interactive terminals, and other cutting-edge equipment. It serves as an important venue for students to conduct theoretical study, practical exercises, and tactical simulation.

Name: Domain Training Grounds
Desc: A specialized training space that utilizes holographic projection and biomimetic simulation technology to construct highly realistic battle scenarios. It serves as the core site for students to conduct tactical drills, combat practice, and coordinated combat training.

Name: Terminal Control Room
Desc: The core management hub responsible for coordinating the organization and evaluation of college qualification examinations, while simultaneously overseeing the operation of daily training systems. It serves as the command and supervision center for all teaching and training-related affairs.

Name: Prism Memorial Plaza
Desc: A large airborne platform within F.O.S., connecting the monument and the Golden Hall. The entire history of F.O.S has been inscribed on the stone tablets scattered throughout the plaza.

Name: F.O.S. Monument
Desc: Though only half of it remains, it is one of the legacies Dominik left in Babylonia, and a spiritual pillar for countless F.O.S. personnel. A small sculpture beneath the monument shows its complete form, constantly reminding people of its former appearance.

Name: Golden Hall
Desc: The large auditorium used for major assemblies within the college. Majestic and solemn, it has welcomed every class since the college was founded, where students gather to pledge themselves to humanity's future.
